data.title: 椎名真由理 · 被窝里的纯情袒露
data.description: 暖和的被褥中，平日里单纯的青梅竹马羞得将半张脸埋在枕头里。睡衣裤管早已褪落在一旁，感受着掌心覆上柔软腰际时的微颤，她带着鼻音软糯地回应着每一次触碰。
data.location: cozy cluttered bedroom under heavy cotton blankets with plush toys nearby
data.action: lying face-down into soft feather pillow, cotton pajamas stripped down, shivering in sweet bashful ecstasy as hands stroke her bare thighs
data.lighting: warm dim glow from an Upa nightlight casting gentle amber across smooth skin
data.mood: innocent pure surrender, heart-pounding bashful pleasure, gentle childhood sweetheart devotion
data.promptProse: Tucked beneath warm quilts with discarded pajama pants, Mayuri buries her blushing face into a pillow, gasping with shy sweet ecstasy.
data.animaCaption: Mayuri lying vulnerable under soft bedsheets, blushing deeply into her pillow with sweet surrender.
